notes.description: Charges for a moment, then one body hit drops an unarmoured player. Hold still, hold your breath.
notes.recoil: `kick` is the legacy camera kick folded into family-style kick (identical to what gunplayOf derived from `recoil.kick`). `recoil` is the legacy spread bloom, kept as it was: the family spread model can't reproduce it exactly (docs/CONTENT_SCALABILITY.md, step 4).
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 5: precision.
notes.design: Charges briefly, then one body hit kills an unarmoured player.
notes.model: The owner's Cyan Charge Plasma Sniper Rifle (Meshy, owned; content/guns.json, 2026-11-28): 1.05 m, held copies a 50,000-triangle cut, its cyan cells lit (glow). It has no scope of its own: the owner's Scope model stands on its flat top (content/optics.json long_scope; aimed through the full-screen scope as before). The kit railgun is the fallback.
